purpose: Recover every previously approved GBA-era sprite identity missing from the current DS placement pool before conversion.
rules: Never downgrade or re-review a legacy approve during recovery.
Prefer an existing native/converted DS asset over reconverting the same design.
If front exists but back is missing, recover/convert only the missing back unless validation fails.
If both front and back already exist, verify and merge directly into placement after DS validation.
Absent identities must locate original GBA source assets before conversion.
